es.L: Y no podían los sacerdotes estar de pie para servir a causa de la nube, porque la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} había llenado la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los sacerdotes no podían quedarse para hacer su servicio a causa de la nube, porque la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estaba llena de la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los sacerdotes no podían quedarse allí para hacer su trabajo a causa de la nube. La gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llenó el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et les prêtres ne purent pas se tenir là pour faire le service, à cause de la nuée, car la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplissait la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Les prêtres ne purent pas rester pour faire leur service, à cause de la nuée, car la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplissait la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les prêtres ne pouvaient pas rester là pour faire leur travail, à cause de la nuée. La gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplissait le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Makuhani hawakuweza kusimama ili kuhudumu kwa sababu ya wingu, kwa maana utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} uliijaza nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Makuhani hawakuweza kusimama kufanya huduma yao kwa sababu ya wingu, kwa kuwa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ilijaa utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Makuhani hawakuweza kusimama pale kufanya kazi yao kwa sababu ya wingu. Utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulilijaza hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Các thầy tế lễ không thể đứng để phục vụ vì đám mây, vì vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy dẫy nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ không thể đứng phục vụ được vì đám mây, bởi nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy dẫy vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ không thể đứng đó làm việc vì đám mây. Vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tràn ngập đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들은 구름 때문에 서서 섬길 수 없었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 가득 채웠기 때문이다.
ko.B: 제사장들은 구름 때문에 서서 섬기는 일을 할 수 없었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 가득 찼기 때문이다.
ko.R: 제사장들은 구름 때문에 그곳에 서서 일을 할 수 없었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 가득 채웠다.

pt.L: E os sacerdotes não puderam ficar de pé para ministrar por causa da nuvem, porque a glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} encheu a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: not able ... for the glory filled the house: as at the tabernacle
decisions.reason: Exodus 40:35 says that Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting, because the cloud had settled on it and the glory of Yahweh filled the tabernacle. The same words are used here of the priests and the house. The parallel in 2 Chronicles 5:14 has the same sentence, and 2 Chronicles 7:1-2 tells of the glory filling the house again after the prayer.

decisions.choice: the glory of Yahweh: his presence made visible
decisions.reason: The glory is Yahweh himself present among his people. By filling the house he shows that he accepts it as his dwelling, as Solomon's words in the next verses say.

decisions.choice: to stand to minister: to stay at their posts and serve
decisions.reason: Priests "stand before Yahweh to minister" (Deuteronomy 10:8; 18:5). The cloud made it impossible to remain in their place.

decisions.choice: the house was full of the glory (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the wording of Exodus 40:35, where the same sentence is used of the tabernacle.

decisions.choice: não puderam / não conseguiam; a glória do SENHOR encheu (L), estava cheia da glória do SENHOR (B), enchia (R)
alternatives: o templo se encheu da glória
decisions.reason: The verse repeats Exodus 40:35 (m1), so each level takes the wording of that verse in Portuguese: Moses "não conseguia entrar" and the tabernacle "estava cheio da glória do SENHOR" (B), "a glória do SENHOR enchia o tabernáculo" (R).

decisions.choice: has said to dwell: has said that he would dwell
decisions.reason: The verb "dwell" is an infinitive after "said". It reports what Yahweh had said about himself; "said" can also mean "decided".

decisions.choice: thick darkness: the dark cloud of Yahweh's presence
decisions.reason: At Sinai Moses drew near to "the thick darkness where God was" (Exodus 20:21; Deuteronomy 4:11; 5:22), and Yahweh appeared in the cloud over the ark's cover (Leviticus 16:2). The cloud that has just filled the house is that darkness: Yahweh is truly present, yet hidden.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew text and its place are kept
alternatives: add the Greek line about the sun and the reference to a book of songs
decisions.reason: In the Greek translation these words come after verse 53, in a longer form that begins with a line about the sun in the heavens and ends by saying that the words are written "in the book of the song". The Hebrew words for "the song" (*hashir*) and "the upright" (*hayashar*) use the same letters in a different order, so the source may be the Book of Jashar quoted in Joshua 10:13 and 2 Samuel 1:18. The Greek may keep an older, fuller form of the poem, or it may expand it; the evidence is not clear. The parallel in 2 Chronicles 6:1-2 agrees with the Hebrew of Kings.

decisions.choice: live in a thick, dark cloud (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says "live" for "dwell" and describes the thick darkness as a dark cloud, linking it with the cloud of verses 10-11.

decisions.choice: lines (\q) as the English; no deity_pronoun span on "habitaría"
decisions.reason: Solomon's short poem is set in lines at every level, as the English is. The English "he/He" for God is carried by the Spanish verb ending, with no written pronoun.

decisions.choice: the words set in lines, as the English does
decisions.reason: Solomon's short saying is set in lines at every level, following the English record's line breaks.

decisions.choice: Solomon's words set in lines and spoken in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: Lines follow the English record; Solomon speaks about God and then to God in the prayer register of the Psalms note.

decisions.choice: a escuridão densa (L), a densa escuridão (B), uma nuvem escura e densa (R)
decisions.reason: The thick darkness of Sinai (m2) keeps the words of Exodus 20:21 in Portuguese at each level; Readable makes it a dark cloud, as Exodus 20:21 does in Portuguese and the English Readable does here.

decisions.choice: "በድቅድቅ ጨለማ" (L, B) for the thick darkness; "በጥቁር ጥቅጥቅ ደመና" (R).
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the dense dark cloud of Sinai (Exodus 20:21), stronger than ordinary darkness; Readable names the cloud as the English does.

decisions.choice: "वे ... निवास करेंगे": honorific plural, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Solomon first speaks of the LORD (honorific "वे"), then turns to him with "तू" in verse 13; Hindi has no capitals, so no deity_pronoun spans here.

decisions.choice: "во мраке" (Literal, Balanced); "в густом тёмном облаке" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The thick darkness is the dark cloud of Yahweh's presence (meaning m2), as at Sinai; Readable says so, as the English does.

am.L: በእርግጥ ከፍ ያለ ቤት ሠርቼልሃለሁ፤ \q ለዘላለም የምትኖርበት ስፍራ።»
am.B: በእውነት ታላቅ ቤት ሠርቼልሃለሁ፤ \q ለዘላለም የምትኖርበት ስፍራ ነው።»
am.R: አሁን እኔ ያማረ ቤተ መቅደስ ሠርቼልሃለሁ፤ \q ለዘላለም የምትኖርበት ስፍራ ነው።»

hi.L: मैंने सचमुच तेरे लिए एक ऊँचा भवन बनाया है, \q तेरे सदा के निवास का स्थान।"
hi.B: मैंने सचमुच तेरे लिए एक भव्य भवन बनाया है, \q एक स्थान जहाँ तू सदा निवास करे।"
hi.R: अब मैंने तेरे लिए एक शानदार मंदिर बनाया है, \q एक स्थान जहाँ तू सदा रह सके।"

ru.L: Построил я, построил {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} дом величия, \q место для {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} пребывания навеки.»
ru.B: Я построил {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} величественный дом, \q место, где {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} будешь пребывать вовеки.»
ru.R: Теперь я построил {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} великолепный храм, \q место, где {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сможешь жить вечно.»

ja.L: わたしは確かに、あなたのために高くそびえる家を建てました。 \q とこしえにあなたが住まわれる所を。」
ja.B: わたしはまことに、あなたのために高くそびえる家を建てました。 \q それは、あなたがとこしえに住まわれる所です。」
ja.R: 今、わたしは、あなたのためにすばらしい神殿を建てました。 \q あなたがいつまでも住まわれる所です。」

uk.L: Я справді збудував {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} величний дім, \q місце для {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} перебування навіки».
uk.B: Я справді збудував {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} високий дім, \q місце, щоб {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} перебував там навіки».
uk.R: Тепер я збудував {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} величний храм, \q місце, де {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зможеш жити навіки».

decisions.choice: a house of loftiness: an exalted, royal dwelling
decisions.reason: The word is rare. It is used of God's "holy and glorious dwelling" in heaven (Isaiah 63:15) and of the dwelling of the sun and moon (Habakkuk 3:11). In related languages it is a title meaning "prince", so the house is a dwelling fit for a king.

decisions.choice: a place for your dwelling: as Moses sang at the sea
decisions.reason: The same words are used in the Song of the Sea: "the place for your dwelling that you have made, Yahweh, the sanctuary" (Exodus 15:17). The word for "place" means a fixed, established place. Solomon sees the house as the fulfillment of that promise. 2 Chronicles 6:2 has the same line.

decisions.choice: I have surely built ... forever
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis. "Forever" is plural in Hebrew, "for ages", meaning for all time.

decisions.choice: magnificent temple (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the rare word with a common one.

decisions.choice: two lines, as the English
decisions.reason: Solomon's short saying is set in lines at every level, as the English level has it; the rest of his prayer is prose.

decisions.choice: Solomon says "con" to God
decisions.reason: In prayer the king speaks as God's servant, with the Genesis note's "con", as in chapter 3.

decisions.choice: uma casa excelsa (L), uma casa sublime (B), um templo magnífico (R); um lugar para a tua habitação (L), morada (B)
decisions.reason: The rare word (m1) says a dwelling of height and dignity, fit for a king: "excelsa" (L) and "sublime" (B) say both. The second line takes the words of the Song of the Sea, Exodus 15:17 in Portuguese, "para tua habitação" (L) and "para a tua morada" (B), so the echo m2 points to can be heard. Solomon turns to God with "tu", as in the whole prayer.

decisions.choice: God addressed as "तू"
decisions.reason: People speaking or praying to God say "तू" (Pentateuch note; 2 Samuel 7:18-29), the intimate address of Hindi prayer. The same through the prayer of verses 23-53.

decisions.choice: "Построил я, построил" (Literal)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew infinitive with the finite verb stresses the deed (meaning m3); Literal repeats the verb, Balanced and Readable carry the stress in "величественный" and "Теперь".

source.text: וַיַּסֵּ֤ב הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶת־פָּנָ֔יו וַיְבָ֕רֶךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכָל־קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹמֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And turned the king his face and blessed all [the] assembly of Israel, and all [the] assembly of Israel [was] standing.

en.L: And the king turned his face around and blessed all the assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel [was] standing.
en.B: Then the king turned around and blessed the whole assembly of Israel, while the whole assembly of Israel stood there.
en.R: Then the king turned around to face all the people of Israel who were gathered there. They were all standing, and he blessed them.

es.L: Y volvió el rey su rostro y bendijo a toda la asamblea de Israel, y toda la asamblea de Israel estaba de pie.
es.B: Luego el rey se dio vuelta y bendijo a toda la asamblea de Israel, mientras toda la asamblea de Israel estaba de pie.
es.R: Luego el rey se volvió hacia todo el pueblo de Israel que estaba reunido allí. Todos estaban de pie, y él los bendijo.

fr.L: Et le roi tourna son visage et bénit toute l’assemblée d’Israël, tandis que toute l’assemblée d’Israël se tenait debout.
fr.B: Puis le roi se retourna et bénit toute l’assemblée d’Israël, et toute l’assemblée d’Israël se tenait debout.
fr.R: Ensuite, le roi s’est retourné vers tout le peuple d’Israël qui était rassemblé là. Ils se tenaient tous debout, et il les a bénis.

sw.L: Mfalme akageuza uso wake, akalibariki kusanyiko lote la Israeli, na kusanyiko lote la Israeli [lilikuwa] limesimama.
sw.B: Kisha mfalme akageuka, akalibariki kusanyiko lote la Israeli, nalo kusanyiko lote la Israeli lilikuwa limesimama pale.
sw.R: Kisha mfalme akageuka kuwaelekea watu wote wa Israeli waliokuwa wamekusanyika pale. Wote walikuwa wamesimama, naye akawabariki.

vi.L: Vua quay mặt lại và chúc phước cho cả hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên, trong khi cả hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên [đang] đứng.
vi.B: Rồi vua quay lại và chúc phước cho cả hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên đang đứng đó.
vi.R: Rồi vua quay lại nhìn toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đang tụ họp ở đó. Mọi người đều đứng, và vua chúc phước cho họ.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 얼굴을 돌려 이스라엘의 온 회중을 축복했다. 그때 이스라엘의 온 회중은 서 있었다.
ko.B: 그리고 왕은 돌아서서 이스라엘의 온 회중을 축복했다. 그동안 이스라엘의 온 회중은 서 있었다.
ko.R: 그리고 왕은 돌아서서 그곳에 모인 이스라엘 백성 전체를 바라보았다. 그들은 모두 서 있었고, 왕은 그들을 축복했다.

pt.L: E o rei voltou o seu rosto e abençoou toda a assembleia de Israel, enquanto toda a assembleia de Israel [estava] de pé.
pt.B: Então o rei se voltou e abençoou toda a assembleia de Israel, enquanto toda a assembleia de Israel estava ali de pé.
pt.R: Então o rei se virou de frente para todo o povo de Israel que estava reunido ali. Todos estavam de pé, e ele os abençoou.

am.L: ንጉሡም ፊቱን መለሰ፤ የእስራኤልንም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ባረከ፤ የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ቆሞ ነበር።
am.B: ከዚያም ንጉሡ ዞሮ የእስራኤልን ጉባኤ ሁሉ ባረከ፤ የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ በዚያ ቆሞ ነበር።
am.R: ከዚያም ንጉሡ በዚያ ተሰብስበው ወደ ነበሩት የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሁሉ ዞረ። ሁሉም ቆመው ነበር፤ እርሱም ባረካቸው።

hi.L: और राजा ने अपना मुँह फेरा और इस्राएल की सारी सभा को आशीष दी, और इस्राएल की सारी सभा खड़ी थी।
hi.B: तब राजा ने मुड़कर इस्राएल की सारी सभा को आशीष दी, और इस्राएल की सारी सभा वहाँ खड़ी रही।
hi.R: तब राजा मुड़कर वहाँ इकट्ठे हुए इस्राएल के सब लोगों की ओर मुँह करके खड़ा हुआ। वे सब खड़े थे, और उसने उन्हें आशीष दी।

ru.L: И обратил царь лицо своё, и благословил всё собрание Израиля, а всё собрание Израиля стояло.
ru.B: Тогда царь обернулся и благословил всё собрание Израиля, а всё собрание Израиля стояло.
ru.R: Потом царь повернулся лицом ко всему народу Израиля, который собрался там. Все стояли, и он благословил их.

ja.L: そして王は顔を向け直して、イスラエルの全集会を祝福した。イスラエルの全集会は立っていた。
ja.B: それから王は振り向いて、イスラエルの全集会を祝福した。イスラエルの全集会は立っていた。
ja.R: それから王は振り向いて、そこに集まっていたイスラエルの人々のほうを向きました。人々はみな立っていました。王は人々を祝福しました。

uk.L: І обернув цар своє обличчя, і благословив усе зібрання Ізраїлю, а все зібрання Ізраїлю стояло.
uk.B: Тоді цар обернувся і благословив усе зібрання Ізраїлю, а все зібрання Ізраїлю стояло.
uk.R: Тоді цар обернувся до всього народу Ізраїлю, що там зібрався. Усі вони стояли, і він благословив їх.

decisions.choice: turned his face: from facing the house to facing the people
decisions.reason: Solomon had spoken his words about the house toward the sanctuary (verses 12-13). Now he turns to the people gathered in the courtyard.

decisions.choice: blessed: spoke words of blessing over them
decisions.reason: To bless the people is to ask God's good for them. The words that follow begin by blessing Yahweh (verse 15), praising him for what he has done for them.

decisions.choice: assembly: Israel gathered for worship
decisions.reason: The word is used of Israel called together before Yahweh, as at Sinai (Deuteronomy 9:10; 18:16).

decisions.choice: all the people of Israel who were gathered there (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "assembly" as the people who had gathered.

decisions.choice: "la asamblea de Israel" (L, B); "todo el pueblo de Israel que estaba reunido" (R)
decisions.reason: The qahal follows the Pentateuch terms list, "la asamblea"; Readable says who they were, as the English does (r-en-1).

source.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר בְּפִ֔יו אֵ֖ת דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י וּבְיָד֥וֹ מִלֵּ֖א לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Blessed [be] Yahweh, [the] God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth with David my father, and with his hand has fulfilled, saying,

en.L: And he said, "Blessed [be] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, who spoke with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mouth to David my father, and with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand has fulfilled [it], saying,
en.B: He said, "Blessed be {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, who with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own mouth made a promise to my father David and with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own hand has now fulfilled it. For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said,
en.R: He said, "Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel! He made a promise to my father David, and now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised. This is what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said:

es.L: Y dijo: «Bendito [sea] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, que habló con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} boca a David mi padre, y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano [lo] ha cumplido, diciendo:
